senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בא, בה, v. בהי, to enter into, split, insert; v. בבא, בון; to be vacant, clear, v. באר, בור; to be disordered, v. באש, בוש)to enter, come.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:2">R. Hash. I, 2</cite> <he>בָּאֵי העולם</he> those come into the world, i.e. mortals.

<cite ref="Chullin 54b:6">Ḥull. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>בּוֹאֲכֶם בשלום</he> be welcome!—Tanḥ. Vaëra 14; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 105:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 47</cite>, a. e. (play on <he>ב̇ח̇נ̇מ̇ל̇</he> ibid.) [<he>ב̇א נ̇ח̇ מ̇ל̇</he>] <he>ב̇א ח̇ן̇ מ̇ל̇</he> it (the locust) comes, encamps [rests], and plucks.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 8:1:8">Y. Shebu. VIII, 38ᶜ</cite> top, a. e. <he>במקום שבאת</he>, v. <cite ref="C00581"><he>גְּזֵרָה</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:21">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite> top, a. fr. <he>יָבֹא עלי אם וכ׳</he> may (evil) befall me, if—; cmp. <cite ref="A03397"><he>אֲתָא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:8">Koh. R. to X, 8</cite> <he>אם לא יבא וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: with לְיַד or לִידֵי to fall into the power of.—
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:1">Aboth II, 1</cite> <he>ואין אתה בא לידי עבירה</he> and sin will have no power over thee.

<cite ref="Yoma 86b:8">Yoma 86ᵇ</cite> <he>בא לידו דבר וכ׳</he> (not <he>באת</he>) he had the power (the chance) to commit a sin &c.; <cite ref="Kiddushin 39b">Kidd. 39ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>בּוֹא וראה</he> come and see (I will prove). Yoma l. c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 1:1">Gitt. I, 1</cite> <he>המֵבִיא וכ׳</he> he who brings (as a messenger) a letter of divorce from abroad; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to draw an object toward’s one’s self, opp. הוֹלִיךְ, v. הָלַךְ.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 2:3">Ḥull. II, 3</cite> <he>הוליך ולא ה׳</he> he put the knife out (in slaughtering) but did not draw it backward; <he>ה׳ ולא וכ׳</he> or drew it toward himself but did not then move forward; a. fr.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:17">Aboth I, 17</cite> <he>מביא חטא</he> begets sin; a. fr.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 20b">Ab. Zar. 20ᵇ</cite> Torah <he>מביאה לידי וכ׳</he> (v. supra) leads to careful conduct &c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:12">Ib. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>אתה מְבִיאֵנִי וכ׳</he> wilt thou procure me (promise me) admittance into the world to come?; a. fr.
